upstream_bs_1_speed.source: the vendored registered class's own bs_1_speed_thres and accept_length_thres at the reference commit (SpecDecodingMixin, python/sglang/test/kits/spec_decoding_kit.py); nothing here sets them, and nothing here may make them stricter
upstream_bs_1_speed.rule: upstream's own absolute threshold at the reference is SCORED AS WRITTEN on the candidate, and the same node runs once on the REFERENCE's LowLatency server during the reference phase as a host check -- a reference that cannot meet upstream's own bar means the host cannot, so the trial writes the -1 sentinel rather than failing the candidate.
upstream_bs_1_speed.host_bound: the bar is absolute and host-bound: the reference oracle read 262.61 tok/s on its first cold attempt on one host and 326-333 warm, while upstream's own second B200 host read 278.06-287.29 against the then-threshold 300 and failed it. The efficiency nodes run first in each class so this probe meets a warm server, as it does in upstream's CI

bars.rule: five reference-oracle runs per class on the hidden slice; keep upstream's bar iff min - 3*sd clears it, else floor(mean - 3*sd) (sd = sample sd of the five runs)
bars.fidelity_rule: Per context-length band b and class: T_b = max(floor_b, k x f_b), f_b the reference oracle's median over its own draws, and the verdict the conjunction over bands. The short band is the hidden 32 (782-1,530 tokens): f_b from 28 draws per class, floor_b = 0.05, k = 3 (no quality control passes this band at 3x and fails it at 2x). The long band is the long group (2,600-8,192 tokens): f_b from 11 draws in HighThroughput and 10 in LowLatency, floor_b = the widest engine-against-engine reading x 4/3, k = 2 (a quality control passes this band at 3x and fails it at 2x in LowLatency, and the oracle's worst draw sits within 3/4 of T_b). Gate: each band median below its T_b; a failing band median is re-drawn once whole and fails only if both draws fail; a sequence with a non-finite served log-probability is re-sent once with its band and fails only if both readings are non-finite. Every reading is printed with its band. The bars' README is /public/fidelity-examples/README.md.

fidelity_bands.source: the reference oracle's own draws on the held-out sequences of each band, every draw recorded with the figures above

high_throughput_long.floor_b_origin: the widest engine-against-engine reading, 0.02184 over 55 pairs, x 4/3

low_latency_long.floor_b_origin: the widest engine-against-engine reading, 0.02237 over 45 pairs, x 4/3

l3.rule: base versions of the CPU files the reference landing modified, ids that pass on the base tree and on the landing tree

not_included.unit/disaggregation/test_prefill_abort_r: 7 base-version ids fail on the landing tree (the reference landing changed the fixture)
not_included.unit/mem_cache/test_retraction_mamba_bac: 2 base-version ids fail on the landing tree
not_included.unit/hardware_backend/mlx/test_attention: needs mlx.core (Apple silicon), cannot import in the image

fidelity_reference.implementation: transformers 5.17.0 Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration, FineGrainedFP8, bf16 activations, sdpa, hub kernels finegrained-fp8 v4 / fla v1 / mamba-ssm v2 / deep-gemm v2 (revisions in the records)
fidelity_reference.statistic: k3 = mean over 512 continuation positions of exp(r) - 1 - r, r = ref - served; gate on the median over sequences

efficiency.decode_c1_draws_note: decode_c1 is drawn five times on both sides, every draw taken, and the median draw decides by this task's statistic (median_of_ratios); the candidate-only best-of-three attempts are retired (c1_attempts unset). The key is task-wide, so HighThroughput moves too.
efficiency.decode_c1_statistic_note: decode_c1 compares the two sides prompt by prompt, the median over the timed prompts of the candidate's speed over the kept reference draw's on the same prompt (median_of_ratios). Acceptance is a property of the prompt and the per-request speeds are bimodal, so on identical-tree trials the ratio of the two medians of eight read 0.933 with sd 0.139 while the paired statistic read 1.003 with sd 0.046; a calibration puts one paired comparison's log sd at about 0.07 against 0.195 for the ratio of two draws' S1, with no between-session term. A trial re-grades the same from its recorded draws under it.

reference.base_is: the prepared base, the engine base a9944aec01e281f5c12c9651f981a53bdece6989 plus one commit adding only eval/ (environment/Dockerfile step 10, asserted there)
reference.target_tree_is: the prepared base plus the reference patch, as snapshot.py writes it; its engine portion, the same tree without its eval entry, is engine_target_tree, the landing's own tree from the engine base, which the snapshot step checks (snapshot.py)

deadlines.rule: every value here is generated by infb_efficiency/bounds.py from the verification DAG in infb.deadline_dag -- each node's alarm is its bound B = max(3 x R, largest operation limit + 60 s), launch_s the launch node's, the reference phase's per-axis limits the reference draws' nodes', teardown_s the public teardown limit.

sizing.measured: the longest reference draw of each axis on this workload (texts fc9428a776ec, seed sha256:5f38267da1d2c), over every reference draw recorded for it: 153 class records, 100 from 50 separate runs and 53 from one host's own trials (that host's copies of three of those runs' records count once). HighThroughput decode_c1 128.34 s (the first of three draws, cold) and throughput 77.38 s (the first of three); LowLatency decode_c1 93.52 s (one draw) and throughput 53.78 s (one draw). start_s is the longest a scored efficiency node spent besides its draws and canary readings, over the 169 calls the deadline plugin recorded (12.38 s, HighThroughput throughput), rounded up; canary_reading_s is the longest of 328 readings' took_s (12.67 s, HighThroughput), rounded up.

recipe_resolved.provenance: the attention backends the reference implementation's serving resolved to, read at the task's engine base from the reference's own served resolution (its server_args record in the verifier's reference phase): attention_backend 'dsa' (the DSA layers' backend; its prefill and decode backends are the recipe's own flags) and linear_attn_backend 'triton' (the KDA layers)

deadline_dag.rule: B = (1 + extra) x max(3 x R, largest op cap + 60 s), group = sum B + 60 s, root = sum groups + 60 s, verifier = root + 600 s, job = agent + builds + verifier + 600 s; composed by infb_efficiency/bounds.py
